claims.claim_text: Witness(es): Business owner (W-1)

On September 26, 2019, at approximately 0237 hours, La Habra Police Department dispatch received an anonymous call reporting multiple subjects dismantling a vehicle in the area of 200 South Alpine Street.
Officers Hartman, K9 Officer Murray, Officer Trainee Ramos, and Sergeant Lowe indicated they would respond.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows multiple officers arriving on scene, including those with K9 units, consistent with the report that officers Hartman, Murray, Ramos, and Lowe responded.

claims.evidence_observations: The claim states the officer observed the chain-link gate at the rear of Metro Auto Sales was open. The bodycam footage shows a chain-link gate that appears to be closed or partially closed, and the officer is approaching from a different angle (near a vehicle), not necessarily from the rear of the gate.
